description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called NoteRequest, used for creating or updating notes within a web application. It includes fields for title and content, validation constraints, constructors, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: A DTO class representing the payload for creating or updating a note, with validation and basic accessors.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.
